spiritgiven.comments: If you retract something you can’t call it again.
Because of the not so good rule knowledge there were problems not only for called rules, but there communication as well. Lack of hand signals made it longer and harder to discuss the calls.

spiritreceived.comments: Latvia was great at communicating effectively and quickly when a spirit issue occurred. They also kept positive attitudes through the game which was also appreciated.

Communication during the game could have been better but then again there wasn’t much reason which is why I opted for a 2 and not a one, that was the only issue outside of that it was a wonderful game.
We think it was really nice to communicate with the Spirit Captains and the Players:)
There are some fast counts calls that are not nessesary, but it is just a small thing.

Dear Latvia Mixed,
We want to thank you for this hard fought quarter final. We really liked playing you guys. Explanation for the 1, I was told by my team that some of you guys didnt know the rules around pick. And since you were running them quite often we think you should look at the rules for that. For the rest it was a clean and spirited game and we hope you do well in the rest of the tournament. 
Greetings NED Mixed

Had very few issues it was a great game, we had small issues, none with the team as a whole but rather with individual plays in the match. There was a dangerous play that was unnecessary, and there was an incident where the disc was down and clear and they refused to admit it was despite their teammate telling them it was. Nothing big just stuff to work toward not doing.
